name: Palmira

queries.query: Palmira Colombia official cadastral parcel map GIS
queries.result: Found first-party IGAC national cadastral open-data documentation and ArcGIS REST metadata for a public cadastral service; found the official Palmira municipal IDEP cadastral viewer lead. Bounded anonymous parcel extraction was not completed because the service returned a pagination error and subsequent bounded requests timed out.

queries.query: Palmira Colombia visor geográfico catastro predios oficial
queries.result: Found the Alcaldía de Palmira circular identifying IDEP as the municipal cadastral cartography viewer, and IGAC’s official Spanish open-data page describing national cadastral data and geoservices. The municipal viewer and REST item routes returned HTTP 500 from this environment; the public IGAC service was inspectable but did not yield a bounded feature response.

registryBasis: A first-party Alcaldía de Palmira circular identifies the IDEP municipal geovisor as publishing Palmira cadastral cartography and associated alphanumeric data. First-party IGAC metadata also exposes a public national cadastral ArcGIS service. These establish custodians and service leads, not successful parcel extraction or source admission.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Palmira municipal cadastral cartography through IDEP; national cadastral data/geoservice through IGAC.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official municipal IDEP viewer route returned HTTP 500 with browser-like headers and cookie jar; viewer JavaScript/config could not be inspected. This is not evidence of absence.
Official ArcGIS item-data route returned HTTP 500; no layer URL or schema was obtained.
IGAC first-party ArcGIS metadata loaded. It lists polygon layers R_TERRENO and U_TERRENO, supports JSON/geoJSON/PBF, and reports service CRS EPSG:4686 (GCS_MAGNA).

U_TERRENO layer metadata loaded. Polygon schema included safe candidate native fields FID (OID), CODIGO, MANZANA_CO, NUMERO_SUB, CODIGO_ANT, GLOBALID_S, and GlobalID. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, or account fields were requested.

A small Palmira bbox in EPSG:4686 with returnGeometry=true, outFields=FID, outSR=4326 and a three-record bound returned HTTP 400 'Pagination is not supported'. Retried without the record bound and as a bounded ID-only query; requests timed out at 30-40 seconds. Exact WUP point was not shifted. No geometry or ID retained.

remainingUncertainty: The municipal IDEP viewer bootstrap was unavailable, and IGAC’s public layer metadata could not be followed to a nonempty bounded Palmira feature response. Therefore current municipal service URL/configuration, live query behavior, parcel native identity semantics, geometry availability at the WUP point, and citywide completeness remain unverified. A zero exact-point hit, timeout, or HTTP 500/400 was not treated as citywide absence.
nextStep: Retry the official IDEP viewer/configuration and IGAC U_TERRENO query when available, using a tiny Palmira bbox and only a stable native ID plus geometry; independently qualify any adapter before runtime admission.
